title: You Hauling Ass? I know I am on this game
author: psdwizzard
selftext:
# 

I am 2 prompts deep in this project. I have a lot left to do. But man it's amazing what Fable can do using Sol as Sub-Agent.

**Assets**  
Image - Comfyui API Local - Model Krea 2 with a Lora  
Sound - ElevenLab via API key
